customMethods.name: configureDatabases
customMethods.script:
# current functionality allows an admin to toggle the available databases
	# the list of databases to enable/disable is store in a property until the admin selects 'Save'
	# based on that list, this function will attempt to enable/disable each one
	# enable means there is a matching configs table and the first row has private=0
	# disabled means the first row has private=1, or there is no matching configs table 
	# for enable: this will check for valid connection, create configs table if necessary, or update the existing matching table with private=0
	# for disable: this will check for valid connection, update the existing matching table with private=1
	# after doing this, we send out a message to open sessions to update their db listing, so they don't have to manually refresh anything
	
	logger = system.util.getLogger('Ad Hoc Trends')
	for dbName in self.view.custom.configureDatabases:
		dbInfo = next((d for d in self.view.custom.databases if d.Name == dbName), False)
		if not dbInfo:
			logger.error('Unable to create configuration table for database "%s" because it was not found in database list (view.custom.databases).' %dbName)
			continue
		
		if dbInfo['Status'] != "Valid":
			logger.error('Unable to create configuration table for database "%s" because database does not have a valid connection.' %dbName)
			continue
		
		dbType = dbInfo['DBType']
		dbEnable = self.view.custom.configureDatabases[dbName]
		
		tableExistsQuery = self.view.rootContainer.getTableExistsQuery(dbType)
		tableFormatMatchesQuery = self.view.rootContainer.getTableFormatMatchesQuery(dbType)
		createTableQuery = self.view.rootContainer.getCreateTableQuery(dbType)
		makeDatabasePrivateQuery = self.view.rootContainer.getMakeDatabasePrivateQuery(dbType)
		
		if not tableExistsQuery or not tableFormatMatchesQuery or not createTableQuery or not makeDatabasePrivateQuery:
			logger.error('Unable to create configuration table for database "%s" because it is an unknown database type "%s".' %(dbName, dbType))
			continue
		
		tableExists = system.db.runScalarPrepQuery(tableExistsQuery, None, dbName)
		
		if dbEnable:
			if tableExists:
				tableFormatMatches = system.db.runScalarPrepQuery(tableFormatMatchesQuery, None, dbName)
				if tableFormatMatches:
					system.db.runPrepUpdate(makeDatabasePrivateQuery, [False, False], dbName)
					logger.info('Enabled database "%s"' %dbName)
				else:
					logger.error('Unable to create configuration table for database "%s" because configuration table but does not match expected format [id,user,public,config, config_name,timestamp].' %dbName)
			else:
				system.db.runPrepUpdate(createTableQuery, None, dbName)
				logger.info('Created configuration table for database "%s"' %dbName)
				system.db.runPrepUpdate(makeDatabasePrivateQuery, [False, False], dbName)
				logger.info('Enabled database "%s"' %dbName)
		else:
			if tableExists:
				tableFormatMatches = system.db.runScalarPrepQuery(tableFormatMatchesQuery, None, dbName)
				if tableFormatMatches:
					system.db.runPrepUpdate(makeDatabasePrivateQuery, [True, True], dbName)
					logger.info('Disabled database "%s"' %dbName)
				else:
					logger.error('Unable to create configuration table for database "%s" because configuration table but does not match expected format [id,user,public,config, config_name,timestamp].' %dbName)
			else:
				# ad hoc trends config table does not exist, so there is no change needed
				pass

	for session in filter(lambda x: x.sessionScope != 'designer', system.perspective.getSessionInfo()):
		system.perspective.sendMessage('ad_hoc_trends_databaseReconfigured', {}, 'session', session.id)

customMethods.script:
# enable means there is a matching configs table and the first row has private=0
	logger = system.util.getLogger('Ad Hoc Trends')
	dbInfo = system.db.getConnectionInfo(dbName)
	if not dbInfo:
		logger.error('Unable to check if database "%s" is enabled because it was not found in database connection list (system.db.getConnectionInfo).' %dbName)
		return False

	dbType = dbInfo.getValueAt(0, 'DBType')
	
	tableExistsQuery = self.view.rootContainer.getTableExistsQuery(dbType)
	tableFormatMatchesQuery = self.view.rootContainer.getTableFormatMatchesQuery(dbType)
	databaseEnabledQuery = self.view.rootContainer.getDatabaseEnabledQuery(dbType)
	
	if not tableExistsQuery or not tableFormatMatchesQuery or not databaseEnabledQuery:
		logger.debug('Unable to check if database "%s" is enabled because it is an unknown database type "%s".' %(dbName, dbType))
		return False

	return bool(system.db.runScalarPrepQuery(tableExistsQuery, None, dbName)) and \
		bool(system.db.runScalarPrepQuery(tableFormatMatchesQuery, None, dbName)) and \
		bool(system.db.runScalarPrepQuery(databaseEnabledQuery, None, dbName))

customMethods.script:
if not dbName or not configId:
		return
	
	logger = system.util.getLogger('Ad Hoc Trends')
	
	configJson = self.view.rootContainer.getConfigJson(includePlots, includeDisplay)
	username = self.session.props.auth.user.userName
	dbInfo = next((d for d in self.view.custom.databases if d.Name == dbName), False)
	if not dbInfo:
		logger.error('Unable to save chart configuration to database "%s" because it was not found in database list (view.custom.databases).' %dbName)
		return

	dbType = dbInfo['DBType']
	
	
	# if the user creates a new chart, then the config id will be a string
	# otherwise it will be a number, representing the existing row to update
	if isinstance(configId, unicode):
		insertChartConfigQuery = self.view.rootContainer.getInsertChartConfigQuery(dbType)
		if not insertChartConfigQuery:
			logger.debug('Unable to save chart configuration to database "%s" because it is an unknown database type "%s".' %(dbName, dbType))
			return
			
		system.db.runPrepUpdate(insertChartConfigQuery, [configJson, configId, private, username], dbName)
		logger.debug('Saved new chart configuration to database "%s"' %dbName)
	else:
		updateChartConfigQuery = self.view.rootContainer.getUpdateChartConfigQuery(dbType)
		if not updateChartConfigQuery:
			logger.debug('Unable to save chart configuration to database "%s" because it is an unknown database type "%s".' %(dbName, dbType))
			return
			
		system.db.runPrepUpdate(updateChartConfigQuery, [configJson, username, private, configId], dbName)
		logger.debug('Updated chart configuration in database "%s"' %dbName)

customMethods.name: getTableExistsQuery
customMethods.script:
if dbType == 'POSTGRES':
		return '''
		SELECT EXISTS(
			SELECT
				*
			FROM
				information_schema.tables
			WHERE
				table_schema NOT IN ('information_schema', 'pg_catalog') AND
				table_type = 'BASE TABLE' AND
				table_name = 'ad_hoc_trends_config')'''
	elif dbType == 'SQLITE':
		return '''
		SELECT EXISTS(
			SELECT
				*
			FROM
				sqlite_master
			WHERE
				type='table' AND
				name='ad_hoc_trends_config')'''
	elif dbType == 'MYSQL':
		return '''
		SELECT EXISTS(
			SELECT
				*
			FROM
				information_schema.tables
			WHERE
				table_name = 'ad_hoc_trends_config')'''
	
	elif dbType == 'MSSQL':
		return '''
		SELECT
			CASE WHEN EXISTS 
			(
				SELECT * 
				FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES
				WHERE TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE'
				AND TABLE_NAME = 'ad_hoc_trends_config'
			)
				THEN 1
				ELSE 0
			END'''
	
	elif dbType == 'ORACLE':
		return '''
		SELECT
			count(*)
		FROM
			dba_tables
		WHERE
			table_name = 'AD_HOC_TRENDS_CONFIG'
		'''
	
	return ''

customMethods.name: getDatabaseEnabledQuery
customMethods.script:
if dbType == 'POSTGRES':
		return '''
		SELECT
			private = false
		FROM
			ad_hoc_trends_config
		WHERE
			id = 0'''
	elif dbType == 'SQLITE':
		return '''
		SELECT
			private = false
		FROM
			ad_hoc_trends_config
		WHERE
			id = 0'''
	elif dbType == 'MYSQL':
		# by deafult, MySQL will auto increment when you try to set an auto increment column to 0 on INSERT.
		# using -1 here instead
		return '''
		SELECT
			private = false
		FROM
			ad_hoc_trends_config
		WHERE
			id = -1'''
			
	elif dbType == 'MSSQL':
		return '''
		SELECT
			CASE WHEN private = 'FALSE'
				THEN 1
				ELSE 0
			END
		FROM
			ad_hoc_trends_config
		WHERE
			id = 0'''
			
	elif dbType == 'ORACLE':
		return '''
		SELECT
			CASE WHEN private = 0
				THEN 1
				ELSE 0
			END
		FROM
			AD_HOC_TRENDS_CONFIG
		WHERE
			id = 0'''
	
	return ''

customMethods.name: getCreateTableQuery
customMethods.script:
if dbType == 'POSTGRES':
		return '''
		CREATE TABLE ad_hoc_trends_config(
			id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
			username text,
			config_name text,
			private boolean,
			config text,
			t_stamp timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
			CONSTRAINT name UNIQUE(username, config_name)
		)'''
		
	elif dbType == 'SQLITE':
		return '''
		CREATE TABLE ad_hoc_trends_config(
			id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
			username TEXT,
			config_name TEXT,
			private INTEGER,
			config TEXT,
			t_stamp TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
			UNIQUE(username, config_name)
		)'''
	
	elif dbType == 'MYSQL':
		return '''
		CREATE TABLE ad_hoc_trends_config(
			id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
			username VARCHAR(255),
			config_name VARCHAR(255),
			private BOOLEAN,
			config TEXT,
			t_stamp TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
			CONSTRAINT name UNIQUE(username, config_name)
		)'''
		
	elif dbType == 'MSSQL':
		return '''
		CREATE TABLE ad_hoc_trends_config(
			id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY IDENTITY(1, 1),
			username VARCHAR(255),
			config_name VARCHAR(255),
			private BIT,
			config TEXT,
			t_stamp DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
			CONSTRAINT name UNIQUE(username, config_name)
		)'''
	
	elif dbType == 'ORACLE':
		return '''
		CREATE TABLE ad_hoc_trends_config(
			id NUMBER GENERATED BY DEFAULT ON NULL AS IDENTITY,
		    username VARCHAR(255),
		    config_name VARCHAR(255),
		    private NUMBER,
		    config NCLOB,
		    t_stamp DATE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
		    CONSTRAINT name UNIQUE(username, config_name)
		)'''
	
	return ''

customMethods.name: getMakeDatabasePrivateQuery
customMethods.script:
if dbType == 'POSTGRES':
		return '''
		INSERT INTO ad_hoc_trends_config
			(id, config, config_name, private, username)
		VALUES
			(0, null, null, ?, null) 
		ON CONFLICT (id) 
		DO UPDATE
			SET
				private = ?
			WHERE
				ad_hoc_trends_config.id = 0
		'''
		
	elif dbType == 'SQLITE':
		# using ? AND ? here to use up to arguments, matching the other SQL queries
		return '''
		INSERT OR REPLACE INTO ad_hoc_trends_config
			(id, config, config_name, private, username)
		VALUES
			(0, null, null, ? AND ?, null)
		'''
	
	elif dbType == 'MYSQL':
		return '''
		INSERT INTO ad_hoc_trends_config
					(id, config, config_name, private, username)
				VALUES
					(-1, null, null, ?, null) 
				ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
					private = ?
		'''
	
	elif dbType == 'MSSQL':
		return '''
		BEGIN TRAN
			UPDATE ad_hoc_trends_config
			WITH (SERIALIZABLE)
			SET private = ?
			WHERE id = 0
			
			IF @@rowcount = 0
			BEGIN
				SET IDENTITY_INSERT ad_hoc_trends_config ON
				INSERT INTO ad_hoc_trends_config
				(id, config, config_name, private, username)
				VALUES
				(0, null, null, ?, null)
				SET IDENTITY_INSERT ad_hoc_trends_config OFF
			END
		COMMIT TRAN
		'''
		
	elif dbType == 'ORACLE':
		return '''
		MERGE INTO AD_HOC_TRENDS_CONFIG a
			USING (SELECT 0 AS ID FROM DUAL d) d
			ON (a.ID = d.ID)
			WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET a.PRIVATE = ?
